blocks.text: **Top five actions:** (1) Isolate or patch exposed Engeniustech Esr600 Firmware (CVE-2025-34035); (2) isolate or patch exposed Crocoblock JetSearch (CVE-2025-49931); (3) isolate or patch exposed JetBooking WordPress plugin (CVE-2026-3496); (4) close previously reported Project MONAI MONAI Label, N-able MailAssure, Idunno AntiCsrf and Drupal Core KEV exposure; (5) examine Engeniustech Esr600 Firmware hosts for unexpected child processes and outbound connections.

**CVE-2025-34035 - Engeniustech Esr600 Firmware OS command injection (CVSS 10).** An OS command injection vulnerability exists in EnGenius EnShare Cloud Service version 1.4.11 and earlier. The usbinteract.cgi script fails to properly sanitize user input passed to the path parameter, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to inject arbitrary shell commands. The injected commands are executed with root privileges, leading to full system compromise. Affected releases (NVD): esr300 firmware = 1.1.0.28; esr300 firmware = 1.3.1.42; esr300 firmware = 1.4.0; +22 more. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-135736 - Ffmpeg out-of-bounds write (CVSS 9.2).** FFmpeg 4.4 before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_deband.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by sending a runtime coupling command. Attackers can send a 'deband coupling 1' command via sendcmd or an unauthenticated zmq filter, making chroma planes be processed at luma dimensions to crash the process or potentially execute code. Affected releases (NVD): ffmpeg >= 4.4, < 9.1. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): ffmpeg 9.1. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

EPSS: 0.7% probability / 53rd percentile (FIRST EPSS). CISA KEV: Not listed in latest verified baseline. Exploitation: No malicious exploitation confirmed by tracked sources. Public exploit code referenced: 1 unvetted GitHub repository; weaponized exploit not verified. Mitigation: Update to a fixed release (ffmpeg 9.1); remove untrusted network reachability until patched; place the service behind authentication or a VPN; monitor for exploitation.

Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

The federal remediation deadline for those entries is **November 27, 2026**. This deadline applies to covered federal agencies under applicable requirements; it is not a universal private-sector mandate.

**Defensive hunting:** for Engeniustech Esr600 Firmware (CVE-2025-34035), inspect unexpected child processes of the service, new scheduled jobs or services, and unusual outbound connections from the host; for Crocoblock JetSearch (CVE-2025-49931), review database errors and anomalous queries originating from the application; for JetBooking WordPress plugin (CVE-2026-3496), review database errors and anomalous queries originating from the application; for CVE-2026-133335 (CVE-2026-133335), inspect unexpected file writes outside the application's data directories, new web-accessible files, modified application code, altered SSH authorized_keys files and suspicious scheduled jobs.
